create_Matcher_with_thresholds: create a Matcher instance with IOU thresholds [0.3, 0.5] and labels [0, -1, 1] for box matching
run_Matcher_call: run the Matcher on an MxN match quality matrix to get ground-truth matches and labels for predictions
review_Matcher_set_low_quality_matches: review the set_low_quality_matches_ method that produces additional matches for predictions with only low-quality matches
test_Matcher_empty_matrix: test the Matcher with an empty match quality matrix to verify it returns default matches and labels
summarize_Matcher_class: summarize the Matcher class that assigns each predicted element a ground-truth element using a match quality matrix
